observations: Three photos show a used automatic transmission unit, likely a 5-speed, lying on a concrete floor in a workshop or scrapyard.
The unit is heavily soiled, with visible rust, grime, and oil residue.
Photo 0 shows the front of the unit with a gear selector and various hoses and belts attached.
Photo 1 shows the side and rear of the unit, with a pink marking on the casing and more hoses and wiring.
Photo 2 shows the top and side of the unit, with electrical connectors and fluid lines visible.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the casing or components in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Mitsubishi Pajero gearbox' with '9 and 10 pin' and '2008 / 2010' model, but no such text is visible in the photos.
The watermark 'DE EKESON MOTORS' is present on all photos, suggesting a seller or listing platform.

claims.evidence: No visible brand or model markings in any photo to confirm Mitsubishi. The seller's text alone is not proof.
No pins or connectors are visible in the photos to confirm the pin count. This cannot be verified remotely.
No year markings are visible on the unit. This cannot be verified remotely.
The unit appears used and dirty; 'best grade' is subjective and cannot be verified from photos alone.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be from a Mitsubishi Pajero or may not be compatible with the claimed model/year.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission casing showing the brand and model stamp, or a photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or service history.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used automatic transmission, not a Mitsubishi Pajero-specific unit

risks.risk: The gearbox may be damaged internally or have worn gears, clutches, or bearings not visible externally.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being rotated or a test run, or a photo of the internal components (if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown internal condition

risks.risk: The gearbox may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle, affecting reliability.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a service history document showing the vehicle's condition before salvage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a salvage unit with unknown history

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
A clear photo of the transmission casing showing the brand and model stamp.
A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or service history document.
A video showing the gearbox being rotated or tested for movement and noise.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
